title: HtmlElement
responsibility: Renders the native element selected by its this property without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlElement.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet provides child content for the selected element. It is called and rendered inside that element only when children is truthy; otherwise no snippet is rendered.

inputs.name: HtmlElement.this
inputs.description: This string selects the native element rendered by <svelte:element>; when omitted, the component uses div.

outputs.name: HtmlElement
outputs.description: The component renders a <svelte:element> selected by this (default div) and spreads every remaining prop onto it. It calls and renders children inside that element only when children is truthy.
